result:
All 14 queries ran against their data files and gave sensible results. I checked X12 by hand against the config.

Three things to know:
- **X14:** the query contains a literal single quote, in the regex for single-quoted values. Wrap it in shell quotes carefully if you run it from a shell. It needs `--raw`, like X9–X11, since `lines` reads the file as text.
- **X4:** the per-customer totals are rounded before ranking, not after. On this data that gives the same top 3.
- **Missing fields:** each query reads optional fields with `query` or `coalesce`, so a missing `discount`, `address`, `labels` or `features` doesn't fail the query.

X1: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","cherry","apple"] | groupBy ~(lower) | map ~(count) | filter ~(gt 1)
X2: get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (query /active | eq true) ~(query /address/country | ne null)) | map ~(get /address/country | upper) | distinct | sort
X3: filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(query {:s ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) :d ~(coalesce /discount 0)} | subOf /s /d) | sum | round 2
X4: filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | groupBy /customer | map ~(map /items | flatten | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2) | entries | map ~(get {:customer ~(get /0 | toString) :total /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /total | desc) /customer]) | take 3
X5: query [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(coalesce ~(it) {} | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) | flatten | map ~(toString) | distinct | sort
X6: query {:dependencies ~(coalesce /dependencies {} | count) :devDependencies ~(coalesce /devDependencies {} | count) :peerDependencies ~(coalesce /peerDependencies {} | count) :optionalDependencies ~(coalesce /optionalDependencies {} | count)}
X7: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce /assignee/login "unassigned" | lower) | map ~(count)
X8: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | filter ~(query /labels | coalesce ~(it) [] | map ~(get /name | lower) | contains "bug") | sort ~(get [~(get /comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~(get /number | toString) | join ","
X9: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(trim | split " " | get {:m /2 :d ~(get /5 | match #"(\d+)ms" | get /1 | toNumber)}) | groupBy /m | map ~(map /d | avg | round 1)
X10: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(trim | split " ") | filter ~(get /4 | toNumber | gte 500) | map ~(get /3 | split "?" | get /0) | distinct | sort
X11: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(trim | split "," | get {:r /1 :c /2 :s /4}) | filter ~(allOf (get /s | eq "up") ~(get /c | ne "")) | groupBy ~(get /r | lower) | map ~(map ~(get /c | toNumber) | avg | round 1)
X12: :d (get /defaults/features) | get /environments | map ~(:e (coalesce /features {} | filter ~(ne null)) | d | merge e | filter ~(eq true) | keys | map ~(toString) | sort)
X13: filter ~(query /salary | ne null) | groupBy /dept | map ~(get {:avg ~(map /salary | avg | round) :count ~(count)}) | entries | map ~(get {:dept ~(get /0 | toString) :avg ~(get /1/avg) :count ~(get /1/count)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /avg | desc) /dept])
X14: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(allOf (ne "") ~(startsWith "#" | eq false)) | map ~(match #"^([^=]*)=(.*)$" | get {:k /1 :v ~(get /2 | coalesce ~(match #"^\"(.*)\"$" | get /1) ~(match #"^'(.*)'$" | get /1) ~(it))}) | get {:db ~(filter ~(get /k | startsWith "DB_") | map ~(get [~(get /k | match #"^DB_(.*)$" | get /1 | lower | toKeyword) /v]) | toMap) :debug ~(filter ~(allOf (get /k | eq "APP_DEBUG") ~(get /v | lower | anyOf (eq "true") (eq "1") (eq "yes"))) | count | gt 0)}
